scope: idealized wind-tide storage/release mechanism screen; no ancient reconstruction
geometry: MI_EAST_RELIEF_V1 with three resolved synthetic backbones

alarm_proxy.noticeable: at least 25% width loss, 0.10 m/s p95 return speed, or 0.05 cm/min route-depth rise
alarm_proxy.urgent: at least one complete lane lost and 50% width loss plus visible current, depth rise, or <=1.5 h route-loss clock
alarm_proxy.acute: local maximum h*u >= 0.70 m2/s; retained only as instability screen
alarm_proxy.warning: operational proxy, not a psychological or fatality model
